predecessors.name: Royal Niger Company
predecessors.text: the Royal Niger Company's territories at and north of Lokoja, whose charter was revoked on 1 January 1900

successors.name: Colony and Protectorate of Nigeria
successors.text: the northern states of Nigeria standing for the Northern Provinces; the lead says the protectorate 'spanned 660,000 square kilometres' (1912 estimate)

ledger.x: 1900 (1 January): the Northern Nigeria Protectorate is proclaimed.
1903: the assault on Kano opens the conquest of the caliphate.
1903: Kano and Sokoto are in British hands.
1903: the caliphate's Nigerian lands pass to the protectorate.
1914 (1 January): the protectorate is merged into the Colony and Protectorate of Nigeria.

wars.name: Battle of Kano
wars.outcome: British victory: the infobox dates the battle 3 February 1903; the Sokoto Caliphate was defeated and its Nigerian lands came under the protectorate.

certainty.note: The northern provinces' frontiers with French Niger and German Kamerun were being fixed by commissions in these years (not on any page opened); inside, emirate boundaries were unsurveyed.
